description: Preview the resolved per-language model stack (STT/LLM/TTS), blockers, warnings, and model diffs for a set of supported languages — without saving. Use before create/update to confirm a multi-language setup is valid.

current_provider_config.description: Existing provider_config to diff against, if any.

language.description: Primary BCP-47 language (defaults to the first supported language).

supported_languages.description: BCP-47 languages to resolve a stack for, e.g. ["hi-IN","en-US"].

workspace.description: Act in this workspace, e.g. one of your client workspaces (id from list_workspaces). Default: the workspace this connection uses.

name: preview_stack
